metadata.description: Clear Claude — a minimal, opinionated Claude Code setup for clear communication without reduced engineering capability.

plugins.name: clear-claude
plugins.description: Ships the Clear Partner output style: answer-first, plain English, concise by default, deep when asked. Keeps Claude Code's coding instructions intact. Includes the clear-doctor and clear-audit diagnostic skills.

plugins.name: clear-ui
plugins.description: Optional status line: model, effort and project on one line; context, 5-hour and weekly usage on the other. Drawn only from the data Claude Code already provides — no network, no credentials, no transcript parsing. Installing it is a separate, reversible step; clear-claude does not depend on it.
